name: com.xiaomi.push.service.receivers.NetworkStatusReceiver
description: Xiaomi Mi Push integrations from Cosmos Photon, Leanplum, MoMagic, Tencent TPNS, or Umeng use this receiver when the network changes to reconnect push and retry pending settings or token synchronization.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Xiaomi push from reconnecting or resuming after a network change.
